controls.name: Tiered rate limiting
controls.detail: Per-IP buckets: 600/60s global, 400/60s read, 90/60s search, 60/60s write, 40/10min sign-in

controls.name: Exponential backoff
controls.detail: Every rate-limit trip doubles the window, capped at 30 minutes

controls.name: Progressive account lockout
controls.detail: 5 failures locks the account; each extra failure doubles the wait to a 1-hour ceiling

controls.name: Username-enumeration defence
controls.detail: Unknown users still pay full scrypt cost and get an identical error message

controls.name: Signed CSRF tokens
controls.detail: HMAC-signed double-submit token required on every POST/PUT/DELETE

controls.name: Split session tokens
controls.detail: Store keeps only publicId + SHA-256(secret); a stolen store cannot be replayed

controls.name: Session fingerprint binding
controls.detail: Tokens are bound to IP + User-Agent; a replay from another client is destroyed

controls.name: Idle + absolute timeouts
controls.detail: 30 minutes idle, 8 hours absolute, token rotated at least every 15 minutes

controls.name: Hardened cookies
controls.detail: HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/, Secure under TLS, generic cookie name

controls.name: SameSite cookie defence
controls.detail: Session cookie is SameSite=Strict — cross-site requests never carry it

controls.name: Security response headers
controls.detail: CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-deny, no-referrer, permissions-policy, COOP/CORP/COEP

controls.name: Technology fingerprinting removed
controls.detail: X-Powered-By and Server headers stripped; CSP advertises no third parties

controls.name: scrypt + pepper hashing
controls.detail: N=2^16, r=8, p=2 (64 MiB) followed by an HMAC pepper held outside the database

controls.name: Password strength policy
controls.detail: 12+ characters, mixed case, digit and symbol; common-password and pattern penalties

controls.name: Password reuse prevention
controls.detail: The last 3 hashes cannot be reused

controls.name: PII encryption at rest
controls.detail: Phone numbers and borrower contacts are sealed with AES-256-GCM under a key held outside the database

controls.name: Searchable encrypted fields
controls.detail: Exact phone lookups use a deterministic HMAC blind index, so ciphertext is never pattern-matched

controls.name: Schema input validation
controls.detail: Every write body validated against a typed schema; unknown and privileged keys rejected

controls.name: SQL injection defence
controls.detail: All queries use bound parameters; a tripwire pattern additionally flags injection attempts

controls.name: Output encoding
controls.detail: Script-src locked to 'self', frame-ancestors 'none', and every value escaped on render

controls.name: Path traversal defence
controls.detail: Static file paths normalised and verified to sit inside the public root

controls.name: Request size limits
controls.detail: 256 KiB body, 2048-character URL, 100 headers

controls.name: Bot detection
controls.detail: Honeypot field plus a minimum submit time; both fail silently with a generic error

controls.name: Mass-assignment defence
controls.detail: role, id, pass_hash and prototype keys are refused from client payloads

controls.name: Tamper-evident audit chain
controls.detail: SHA-256 hash chain + Merkle tree + proof-of-work, sealed outside the database

controls.name: Concurrent session cap
controls.detail: A user may hold at most 5 live sessions; older ones are evicted

controls.name: Global session revocation
controls.detail: Password change or account unlock terminates every active session

controls.name: Risk-event reauthentication
controls.detail: Privilege changes force a new session; fingerprint anomalies force re-authentication

controls.name: Role-based authorisation
controls.detail: Admin-only actions are gated server-side; attempts are logged as privilege escalation
